name: linear
description: Linear as a ticket provider: issues in the configured teams become ticket records, workflow-state changes become ticket-status-change events, issue comments become ticket-comment documents, and the host can comment on an issue (ticket.comment) and move it to a workflow column (ticket.transition). Installs as a Linear app user (actor=app) so Papercusp is delegated issues instead of being assigned them. Synced by the host's connector driver; the plugin only maps Linear's GraphQL API.
author: Papercusp

identity.body: {"query":"query PapercuspIdentity { organization { id name urlKey } viewer { id name } }"}
